items.q: I never heard of Elmer Snowd@n or Rex Stewart.

ctx.x: Well, he had Elmer Snowd@n was there and Roy, and Rex Stewart.....

Joe Williams, the trombone player. A guy they called Jazz, he used to be a drummer. And all kinds of piano players you never even heard of. Oh, those piano players.
